features.title: Unified agent activity feed
features.summary: Normalizes session, communication, and jj integration events into one durable chronological feed with deduplication, bounded retention, cursor pagination, filtering, search, and provenance.
failureModes: A duplicate delivery is deduplicated by event id instead of appended twice.
Out-of-order timestamps are re-sorted on ingest.
A malformed ingest payload is rejected instead of stored.
Missing sources (no jj coordinator, no communication) leave the feed usable rather than failing.
The retained window is bounded, so old events age out predictably.

externalDependencies.boundary: Optional cross-plugin cordis events (dshfiles/activity/event) plus a bounded backfill request; the timeline never runs jj itself.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Adapters are exercised directly in src/service.test.ts; the jj adapter boundary is validated without the coordinator running.

externalDependencies.boundary: Optional cross-plugin cordis events for message and communication-tool activity; no communication state is read directly.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Adapter mapping is unit-tested with fixed payloads.

features.title: Deterministic condensation and attention visibility
features.summary: Collapses routine runs and correlated events into traceable groups while keeping errors, blocked integrations, and attention-required events individually visible; a detailed mode expands every retained event.
failureModes: A summary always carries the ids of its underlying events so it stays traceable.
Attention events are never folded into a routine group.
Condensation is deterministic, so repeated renders produce the same feed.
